citations.quote: The lowest degree of transparency is found in so-called dark pools of liquidity, trading
Markets that quickly report quotes and orders are ex ante transparent.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Transparency is the amount of pre- and post-trade information disclosed; more quote visibility erodes dealer search-cost rents and tightens spreads for the uninformed, while dark pools (lowest transparency) let large traders hide intentions, with ambiguous net liquidity effects.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Market Transparency, Dark Pools, and the Transparency-Liquidity Tradeoff
